Statistics exercise books in **R, JASP and SPSS**, made for students at several universities — and for one-to-one help. Step by step, with animals that behave badly and statistics that slowly becomes clear.

They are being translated one at a time. What is in English comes first; everything under *In Dutch* is in Dutch.

### The R exercise book [on its way]{.cc-chip .cc-chip-straks}
The exercise book that goes with *The Regressive Backbone*, chapter by chapter, in **R**. Nothing to read yet; it gets a link here as soon as its first chapter is up.
:::

### Psychometrics Practice Book [on its way]{.cc-chip .cc-chip-straks}
For a second-year course in psychology at Leiden University, in **R**. Nothing to read yet; it gets a link here as soon as its first topic is up.
:::

## In Dutch

All of these are in Dutch. [The Dutch shelf](../../oefenboeken/index.html){hreflang="nl"} says more about each one.

<!-- BEN: de titels zijn Engels met "(in Dutch)" erin, zoals "The book (in Dutch)" tot vandaag op
     de thuispagina stond; de Nederlandse titel ("Het R-oefenboek") zegt een Engelse lezer niets.
     De volgorde is die van de Nederlandse plank: bij het boek, de voorloper, op maat, losse vakken. -->

::: {.cc-plank}

::: {.cc-boek}
### [The R exercise book (in Dutch) →](../../oefenboeken/broertjes/r/index.html){hreflang="nl"} [R]{.cc-chip}
The book's own exercise book in **R**: the same topics in the same order, and you run the code yourself, the shuffling simulations included.
:::

::: {.cc-boek}
### [The JASP exercise book (in Dutch) →](../../oefenboeken/broertjes/jasp/index.html){hreflang="nl"} [JASP]{.cc-chip}
The same material in **JASP**: click paths instead of code, with the shuffling toys in your browser.
:::

::: {.cc-boek}
### [The SPSS exercise book (in Dutch) →](../../oefenboeken/broertjes/spss/index.html){hreflang="nl"} [SPSS]{.cc-chip}
The same material in **SPSS**, through the *Analyze* menus.
:::

::: {.cc-boek}

### [The JASP handbook (in Dutch) →](../../manuscript/handleiding/index.html){hreflang="nl"} [JASP]{.cc-chip}
*Handleiding Statistiek met JASP*, the handbook that was there before the book — monkeys and all. It belongs to no single course, so you can use it alongside any.
:::

::: {.cc-boek .cc-boek-maat}
<!-- MIEKE: "GGZ-VS/JASP-oefenboek" — gekozen "For mental-health nurse specialists". GGZ-VS is een
     Nederlandse opleidingscode (verpleegkundig specialist in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg) en die
     zet het huis niet in lezerstekst. Alternatief: "Reading research, for nurse specialists". -->
### [For mental-health nurse specialists (in Dutch) →](../../oefenboeken/ggz_vs/index.html){hreflang="nl"} [JASP]{.cc-chip}
Made for nurse specialists in training. Here you don't run an analysis yourself: you read someone else's, and judge whether you believe it.
:::

::: {.cc-boek .cc-boek-vak}
### [Psychometrics (in Dutch) →](../../oefenboeken/psychometrie/index.html){hreflang="nl"} [R]{.cc-chip}
A second-year course in psychology at Leiden University: working R code with its output, next to the course's own R practicals.
:::

::: {.cc-boek .cc-boek-vak}
### [Multivariate Data Analysis (in Dutch) →](../../oefenboeken/mvda/index.html){hreflang="nl"} [R]{.cc-chip}
Also for psychology at Leiden: from multiple regression to mediation, with working R code and its output, next to the course's own exercise book.
:::

::: {.cc-boek .cc-boek-vak}
<!-- MIEKE: "OZP 1" is een vakcode (Onderzoekspracticum 1); gekozen "Research Practicum 1".
     "Pedagogiek" is in Leiden in het Engels "Education and Child Studies". -->
### [Research Practicum 1 (in Dutch) →](../../oefenboeken/ozp1/index.html){hreflang="nl"} [SPSS]{.cc-chip}
A first-year course in education and child studies at Leiden University: working by hand and theory first, with SPSS as a check.
:::
